summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, announcing its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for September 17, 2026, in Petach Tikva, Israel. The notice covers routine agenda items: re-election of two Class III directors, an amendment to increase authorized share capital from 100 million to 150 million ordinary shares (NIS 500,000 increase), approval of two equity grants to CEO Erez Meltzer, and reappointment of Kesselman Kesselman (PwC member firm) as auditors. Record date is August 18, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance matter with no special-situation elements; shareholders can vote by proxy or in person. No deal terms or strategic actions are involved.
